the_fix: medicham2 gains the authority's SECOND in-move `eachEvent('Update')` — data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:575 (mainline sim/battle-actions.ts:1003), below `applyRecoilDamage` (:554 / :982) and above `afterMoveSecondaryEvent` (:577 / :1005). why_it_is_board_material_and_not_narrati: medicham2 calls `_updateAll()` from two sites and BOTH sit under `if(sideWiped(S)){...break _TURN;}` (medicham2-browser.js:25190 and :37700). A move that ends the battle therefore never reaches the pass at all, and the attacker keeps a berry the authority ate. Everywhere else the two engines coincide, because nothing is emitted between the recoil and the next action's pass — which is why the whole-game population shows exactly TWO games and not two hundred.

why_it_might_miss_HIGH_more_divergences_: The pass now settles a berry INSIDE the move in every game that carries one, not only in the two that end there. That does not change a board on its own — the between-action pass settled the same berry a moment later — but a berry eaten one action earlier changes `effSpeed` for an Unburden holder and changes the HP a later handler reads, and either can surface a divergence the old ordering was standing in front of. Batch D's one miss was exactly this shape: two named causes went to zero and one game re-parted on a NEW cause.
why_it_might_miss_LOW_fewer_divergences_: Neither of the two named games is the ONLY thing wrong with it. If a game parts again immediately on a second cause the board count moves by 1 instead of 2. It is also possible that a third, unnamed game in the 5 board-parted rows the `any` join does not cover (board parted BEFORE the protocol did, so it carries no cause row) is the same defect and closes too — which would read as 43.
